company.name: Miamin Corp
company.shortDescription: Miamin Corp is an information technology company that provides cyber security, network security, and cloud security solutions.
company.description:
“Miamin Systems Inc.”  is a global business transformation agency delivering innovation with a purpose. We enable clients to anticipate tomorrow’s trends and connect more directly with consumers across their digital touch points while optimizing time-to-market and ROI.

We are a network of more than 200 innovators, design thinkers, marketers, creatives and developers spanning 5 continents with offices in 3 countries (Dubai, United Arab Emirates| Bangalore, INDIA ).

While our expertise is in technology, marketing and experience design, our passion is in addressing transformational business challenges for our clients, including strategy consulting, service design, technology services, and optimization of business-critical digital platforms for multichannel e-commerce and marketing.

For more information, visit www.miamincorp.com
